title: Silicon Volley: Designers Tap Generative AI for a Chip Assist
description: A research paper released today describes ways generative AI can assist one of the most complex engineering efforts: designing semiconductors. The work demonstrates how companies in highly specialized fields can train large language models (LLMs) on their internal data to build assistants that increase productivity.
